==Starting off== Early levels can be skipped by completing [[Quest experience rewards#Fletching|quests that give Fletching experience]]. Completing [[Animal Magnetism]], [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]] and [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] will grant a total of 3,262 Fletching experience, which will get the player up to level 18. These quests have few requirements and can be done at a low level. Completing [[Temple of Ikov]] and [[The Fremennik Trials]] will grant an additional 10,812 Fletching experience, which will get the player up to level 30. {| class="wikitable sortable lighttable qc-active" style="text-align:center;" !Quest !Experience
